I want to add that there are several points in the game where Jimmy pushed boundaries and abused his crewmates.
- He verbally abuses Anya and makes her live in fear of him (like how a real abuser would)
- He knocks out Swansea with a spiked drink (and that also implies he's done it before given that he knows the recipe.)
- He pressures Daisuke to a job that he knows is unsafe especially given the state of the ship
- When he gives curly his painkillers, the audio implies more of a struggle going on between him as the game goes on. He forces the painkillers into curly (or perhaps curly couldn't ingest them normally?)
Jimmy is a serial abuser. On Earth and on the ship

To also show the type of person Jimmy was at the beginning, there is a whole process to crashing the entire ship. 
1. going to the cock pit 
2. sitting down
3. steering the ship
4. getting a key
5. turning the key
6. turning off autopilot
At any point he could have stopped, but he was only thinking about himself. He was absolutely okay with ruining the lives of other people. That's how rapists and abusers are and Jimmy turned out to be both. He felt emasculated, out of control, or threatened by those in power. He always goes on about how jealous he is of curly despite being his best friend. 

I think what this game really tries to get at is the consequences of being a bystander/enabler. None of this would have happened if Curly had done something about Jimmy the instant he learned about what he did to Anya. As a consequence for his actions, the ship is crashed and now he is made to watch everything unfold in his morbidly crippled state. He's made to feel powerless like Anya because he didn't take action. 

Remember that conversation curly had with Anya about the big screen having a dead pixel? That dead pixel is supposed to be Jimmy, but curly says he wouldn't notice it because he's more of a big picture guy. Anya through out the story tried to tell Curly directly and indirectly about what happened to her so many times and he did nothing. 

Another thing, when Jimmy feels the consequences of his actions catching up to him he's only thinking about Curly's approval. He's always been apologizing to curly only. He does not even utter or think about the affect he had on Anya. It's always back to "fixing this" with Curly. Polle(the mascot) comments on that in his conversation with jimmy by asking "If all of this is true... then why are you still so concerned with him?" I really like how Polle cut him off when he was about to say Anya's line "Our worst moments don't make us monsters" because Anya was saying that because of Jimmy. Like he was so disconnected that he really thought he was trying to do right by not even acknowledging what he did to Anya as the part of the problem.

Edit: It has been pointed out to me that there is a little error with the comment I made about the spiked drink in relation to Anya. The crew didn't have access to the mouthwash at the time so it wouldn't make sense for Anya to be taken advantage of that way. Anya asked Curly that there were locks in medical but not in the sleeping quarters and Curly answered "Safety". To add to that Anya even knew that the estimate of just under eight months so around that time, it's definitely sinking for her as to what happened. 

So of course Jimmy would have found his way in to her room directly. There are locks in the cockpit and medical but not the sleeping quarters. The ship has all men and one woman. That design choice for the ship is very risky especially because the ship is in space for over a year.  No wonder that to Anya locking herself in medical was the best decision she'll ever make. 

Edit 2: It is plausible that Jimmy forced the painkillers into Curly's throat because he couldn't swallow them himself. Though I do want to point out Jimmy's other feelings toward Curly despite his admiration and respect for him. He is envious of him. 

Curly had a conversation with Jimmy during his psych evals and Jimmy did mention that it was annoying hearing about how great of a leader Curly was. As the game progresses Jimmy

At 41:29 he lets it all loose basically saying that he feels like curly is leaving all of them behind. In a way also gaslighting him into thinking it's his fault for pony express letting them all go.

Later in the game while Jimmy is captain 57:33 he does acknowledge that Curly's is stressful. He's been taking in what it actually means to be in control and take responsibility every time he gives curly his meds. 

Perhaps Jimmy didn't necessarily abuse curly, but he definitely felt threatened by his superiority as captain. I'm a little lost on why Jimmy cut off Curly's leg at 1:31:59, but I would say it is related to his envy because of his line "life isn't even worth living at the same level as us"

To those confused, the plot, as written in Wikipedia:

During a routine shipment, the Pony Express freighter spaceship Tulpar is sabotaged into crashing into an asteroid. The crew – consisting of captain Curly, co-pilot Jimmy, medic Anya, mechanic Swansea, and last-minute intern Daisuke – survive. However, most of the ship's resources are blocked off by airbag-like foam, damage to which could potentially breach the ship's hull and trigger lethal decompression. Curly is also mutilated by the crash and cannot speak or move; he is kept alive via a dwindling supply of painkillers. Jimmy declares himself acting captain as a result, claiming that Curly caused the crash after going postal.
When food and medical supplies begin to run low after two months, the crew decides to open their confidential shipment in the hope that it has supplies they can use. But discover that it consists solely of mouthwash which will poison them if they continually consume it. Swansea decides to break his sobriety and consumes the mouthwash due to its alchohol content, the increasing intoxication of Swansea inflaming tensions further. Jimmy, who has been forced to feed Curly the painkillers because Anya continually can't bring herself to do so, attacks and force feeds him in a rage.
Eventually, Anya locks herself in the medical bay with Curly. After failing to convince a drunken Swansea to help him break in, Jimmy knocks him out with the ship's sole bottle of rubbing alcohol and sneaks into the utility bay to find tools. After discovering that Swansea was guarding the ship's only working cryopod, Jimmy believes that Swansea was saving it for himself, and coerces Daisuke into crawling through a damaged vent to reach Anya and Curly. Daisuke makes it through, but is severely injured in the process. Due to the missing rubbing alchohol, Jimmy uses the mouthwash as an impromptu antiseptic, only for it to worsen Daisuke's pain and injuries. Swansea, who despite early annoyed behaviour towards him, had come to care for Daisuke, choosing to reluctantly and crudely euthanize him with a fire axe. Jimmy goes into the medical bay, where Anya is revealed to have killed herself via an overdose. Jimmy finds the ship's emergency revolver and is then attacked by a vengeful Swansea.
Flashbacks to the days leading up to the crash reveal that the Tulpar crew were due to be laid off following their delivery due to Pony Express going out of business. At his birthday party, Curly breaks the news prematurely, distressing his crewmates as he would be given a recomendation for a high paying job afterwards, Jimmy believing Curly to be abandoning the crew to pursue a better career. Later, in a private conversation with Curly, Anya reveals that she is pregnant with Jimmy's child, it being implied that Jimmy raped her. Curly attempts to ease tensions with Jimmy, only for Anya to reveal her pregnancy to Jimmy behind Curly's back. Curly confronts Jimmy but tries to excuse his actions due to their history together. Jimmy convinces Curly that him being punished will make things worse for the crew, Curly choosing to let him go. The stress of his impending layoff, his jealousy of Curly, and the possibility of being held accountable for Anya's pregnancy after the delivery, are ultimately what drives Jimmy to crash the "Tulpar" in a failed murder-suicide bid, Curly's injuries being a result of him trying to save the crew by stopping it from crashing.
Jimmy is hunted down by Swansea, hallucinating that the ship has become a maze, and later finding himself in a graveyard where he has to fight off Swansea. Jimmy uses the revolver to kill Swansea, who in his final moments, condemns Jimmy's cowardice and selfishness while admitting to his own faults, with it being implied that the cryo pod was actually intended for Daisuke. His sanity rapidly declining, Jimmy holds a mock birthday party with the crew's corpses. He proceeds to cut off and consume part of Curly's leg, then force-feeds the captain his own flesh in a surreal hallucination. After a series of additional visions where he is chased by a deformed mass of horse statues, Jimmy finds himself confronted by the Pony Express mascot 'Polle', who mocks him for his faults and actions. Jimmy concludes that he can redeem himself if he ensures Curly's survival, placing him in the cryopod. He then apologizes to Curly for hurting him before killing himself with the revolver, believing he has successfully fixed their situation. The game's credits roll as Curly is placed into a 20-year cryosleep, his fate left uncertain.
